info.title: agent-team
info.description: Local multi-agent development service (docs/spec.md §11). Generated from @agent-team/protocol; do not edit by hand.

Error.description: Error envelope `{ error: { code, message, hint? } }`

bearerAuth.description: Local listener: the token from DATA/run/listener.json (new on every start). The LAN listener takes no credential (docs/adr/0024).

get.summary: Board snapshot; continue live with GET /api/events?after=<last_seq>
Server-sent events: replay after a seq cursor, then live
get.description: First frame: `{"type":"server.connected","last_seq":N,"ts":…}`. Then one frame per stored event (`id:` = seq, `data:` = the event record as JSON), first the events after the cursor (`after`, else `Last-Event-ID`, else only new events), then live. A comment line is sent as heartbeat every `sse.heartbeat_ms` (15 s). A client that falls behind by more than `sse.max_queue` events is disconnected and reconnects with its cursor.
